benefits.title: Nitrogen and yield carry-over from legumes
benefits.text: Legume-to-next-crop sequences in this plan (phaseolus bean then wheat) are the pattern that rotation studies link to higher yield in the following crop: 23% on average for legume pre-crops versus 16% for non-legumes in 3,663 field comparisons worldwide. In sub-Saharan Africa, effects were larger after soybean and groundnut than after cowpea, and larger for maize than for millet or sorghum.
conditions: Average of many trials, not a forecast for your field; roughly one trial in four showed no gain or a loss.
The gain shrinks where nitrogen fertiliser use is high.
